# `/identities` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /identities/v1

`listIdentitiesV1` — List identities

This API returns a list of identities.

- Scopes: idn:identity:manage, idn:identity:read
- Parameters:
  - `filters` (query) — fields: id: eq, in; name: eq, sw; alias: eq, sw; firstname: eq, sw; lastname: eq, sw; email: eq, sw; cloudStatus: eq; processingState: eq; correlated: eq; protected: eq — e.g. `id eq "6c9079b270a266a60170a2779fcb0006" or correlated eq false`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: name, alias, cloudStatus — e.g. `name,-cloudStatus`
  - `defaultFilter` (query) — default CORRELATED_ONLY — one of CORRELATED_ONLY, NONE — Adds additional filter to filters query parameter. CORRELATED_ONLY adds correlated=true and returns only identities that are correlated. NONE does not add any and returns all identities that satisfy…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
- Returns 200: array of identity

### GET /identities/v1/{id}

`getIdentityV1` — Identity details

This API returns a single identity using the Identity ID.

- Scopes: idn:identity:manage, idn:identity:read
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Identity Id
- Returns 200: identity

### DELETE /identities/v1/{id}

`deleteIdentityV1` — Delete identity

The API returns successful response if the requested identity was deleted.

- Scopes: idn:identity:manage
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Identity Id
- Returns 204: no body

### GET /identities/v2/{id}

`getIdentityV2` — Identity details (search) — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns a single identity from the identities search index. `privilegeLevel.effective` is `HIGH`, `MEDIUM`, `LOW`, or `NONE`. An identity with no privilege level is returned as `NONE` Comparisons on `privilegeLevel.effective` are case-insensitive, and returned values are uppercase.

- Scopes: idn:identity-self:read, idn:identity:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Identity Id
- Returns 200: identityv2

### GET /identities/v1/{identityId}/ownership

`getIdentityOwnershipDetailsV1` — Get ownership details

Use this API to return an identity's owned objects that will cause problems for deleting the identity. Use this API as a checklist of objects that you need to reassign to a different identity before you can delete the identity. For a full list of objects owned by an identity, use the [Search API](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/search-post-v-1). When you search for identities, the returned identities have a property, `owns`, that contains a more comprehensive list of identity's owned…

- Scopes: idn:identity:read
- Parameters:
  - `identityId` (path, required) — Identity ID.
- Returns 200: identityownershipassociationdetails

### POST /identities/v1/{id}/reset

`resetIdentityV1` — Reset an identity

Use this endpoint to reset a user's identity if they have forgotten their authentication information like their answers to knowledge-based questions. Resetting an identity de-registers the user and removes any elevated user levels they have.

- Scopes: idn:identity:manage
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Identity Id
- Returns 202: no body

### GET /identities/v1/{identityId}/role-assignments

`getRoleAssignmentsV1` — List role assignments

This returns either a list of Role Assignments when querying with either a Role Id or Role Name, or a list of Role Assignment References if querying with only identity Id.

- Scopes: idn:identity-direct-report:read, idn:identity:manage, idn:identity:read
- Parameters:
  - `identityId` (path, required) — Identity Id to get the role assignments for
  - `roleId` (query) — Role Id to filter the role assignments with
  - `roleName` (query) — Role name to filter the role assignments with
- Returns 200: array of object

### GET /identities/v1/{identityId}/role-assignments/{assignmentId}

`getRoleAssignmentV1` — Role assignment details



- Scopes: idn:identity-direct-report:read, idn:identity:manage, idn:identity:read
- Parameters:
  - `identityId` (path, required) — Identity Id
  - `assignmentId` (path, required) — Assignment Id
- Returns 200: roleassignmentdto

### POST /identities/v1/{identityId}/synchronize-attributes

`synchronizeAttributesForIdentityV1` — Attribute synchronization for single identity. — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This end-point performs attribute synchronization for a selected identity. The endpoint can be called once in 10 seconds per identity.

- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `identityId` (path, required) — The Identity id
- Returns 202: identitysyncjob

### POST /identities/v1/invite

`startIdentitiesInviteV1` — Invite identities to register — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API submits a task for inviting given identities via email to complete registration. The invitation email will include the link. After selecting the link an identity will be able to set up password and log in into the system. Invitations expire after 7 days. By default invitations send to the work identity email. It can be changed in Admin > Identities > Identity Profiles by selecting corresponding profile and editing Invitation Options. This task will send an invitation email only for…

- Scopes: idn:password-user-invite:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, HELPDESK
- Body (application/json): inviteidentitiesrequest
- Returns 202: taskstatus

### POST /identities/v1/{id}/verification/account/send

`sendIdentityVerificationAccountTokenV1` — Send password reset email — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API sends an email with the link to start Password Reset. After selecting the link an identity will be able to set up a new password. Emails expire after 2 hours.

- Scopes: idn:password:user-invite
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, HELPDESK
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Identity ID
- Body (application/json): sendaccountverificationrequest
- Returns 200: no body

### POST /identities/v1/process

`startIdentityProcessingV1` — Process a list of identityids — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This operation should not be used to schedule your own identity processing or to perform system wide identity refreshes. The system will use a combination of [event-based processing](https://documentation.sailpoint.com/saas/help/setup/identity_processing.html?h=process#event-based-processing) and [scheduled processing](https://documentation.sailpoint.com/saas/help/setup/identity_processing.html?h=process#scheduled-processing) that runs every day at 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM in the tenant's timezone…

- Scopes: idn:identity:manage, idn:identity:process
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, HELPDESK
- Body (application/json): processidentitiesrequest
- Returns 202: taskresultresponse

### POST /identities/v1/{identity-id}/set-lifecycle-state

`setLifecycleStateV1` — Set lifecycle state

Use this API to set/update an identity's lifecycle state to the one provided and update the corresponding identity profile.

- Scopes: idn:identity-lifecycle-state:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `identity-id` (path, required) — ID of the identity to update.
- Body (application/json): object
- Returns 200: object
